name: Offline Python Builder
description: Build offline Python install repositories with all dependencies
author: FengYu

aiTools.name: offlinepython_doctor
aiTools.description: Diagnose the host Python and pip environment for offline-build readiness.
aiTools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"executable":{"type":"string","title":"Python executable","description":"Leave empty to detect Python automatically"}}}

aiTools.name: offlinepython_search_deps
aiTools.description: Search PyPI for available wheels for a package.

aiTools.name: offlinepython_init_project
aiTools.description: Initialize an offline-Python project in a writable directory.
aiTools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"projectDir":{"type":"object","title":"Project directory","description":"Writable directory selected from FengYu files"}},"required":["projectDir"]}

aiTools.name: offlinepython_verify
aiTools.description: Verify an offline-build output against its manifest.

aiTools.name: offlinepython_build_start
aiTools.description: Start an offline wheelhouse build and return its job ID.
aiTools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"projectDir":{"type":"object","title":"Project directory","description":"Project directory selected from FengYu files"},"executable":{"type":"string","title":"Python executable","description":"Leave empty to detect Python automatically"}},"required":["projectDir"]}

aiTools.name: offlinepython_build_status
aiTools.description: Poll an offline-build job and return logs and its final result.
